text:
alex: Heads-up — canary failed when a request from us-east tried to failover to eu-west. eu model is q4_0, us model is q8_0 and the runtime aborted with a dtype mismatch. :grimacing:
diego: Ugh. can you paste the exact error?
alex: ```
Error: ModelLoadError: incompatible quant format
  expected: q8_0
  found: q4_0
  layer: 72
Fallback aborted -> 503 returned to client
```
rachel: Are we intentionally building different quant artifacts per region?
alex: Yes — EU builds use q4_0 to save GPU memory for lower-tier Dedicated pools. Some EU tenants require it due to constrained hardware.
morgan: Runtime can't transparently convert q4->q8 without a conversion step or recompile. options: unify artifact, add a converter at load time, or change routing so fallback only goes to compatible artifacts.
priya: Legal constraint: a subset of customers disallow weights to be copied across regions. So "unify by copying US weights to EU" is a non-starter for those.
diego: Could publish both artifacts to a central registry and let each region pull the compatible one. but for private deployments that still violates residency unless the weights are built in-region.
elena: Another idea: lazy upcast converter that runs at load-time for warm pool nodes (one-off CPU cost) — keep binary local but on-disk format converted for runtime use. saves network movement.
alex: Load-time conversion benchmark on a 16vCPU box will add ~6–12s per model load for medium models. For live fallback that's too slow unless we pre-warm.
sam: For the short term: prefer routing change. If target fallback region has incompatible artifact, route to the nearest region with same quant-level or fallback to a smaller model in-region (e.g., 3B) with degrade notice.
rachel: Agreed. We need an operator playbook: if fallback artifact incompatible -> do NOT auto-forward client to incompatible region. Instead return a degraded response with telemetry tag and increment metric.
diego: I'll draft an RFC with a constraint matrix: residency vs artifact compatibility vs latency vs cost. propose three concrete mitigation paths: (1) artifact convergence (policy + infra), (2) load-time conversion shim (perf + prewarm strategy), (3) routing + smaller-model fallback + explicit client degrade.
priya: Add legal sign-off workflow to any option involving cross-region weight transfer.
morgan: Also add manifest-level headers for model artifacts: e.g., `model-format: q4_0` and checksum. Runtime can preflight and make routing decision before attempting load.
alex: +1 on preflight header. let's surface `model-format` in the model metadata endpoint and in health/handshake so proxy can make quick decisions.
elena: I'll prototype a naive q4->q8 upcast converter and run perf numbers against our warm-pool profile tomorrow.
alex: For immediate canary: ops, please pause further EU canaries for this model until we have at least routing mitigations and metrics.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary for `gen-v2-medium` halted in eu-west-3 — aborting remaining host rollouts.
alex: Thanks. diego please start the RFC and cc legal + security. I'll add telemetry metrics we need (`quant-incompat-fallback`, `fallback-to-smaller-model`, `model-format-mismatch-rate`).
diego: Will do. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.
alex: Great — appreciate the quick sync. :eyes:
